name: Tsushima (Nagasaki, Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Tsushima city emblem in green: a stylised flower of five swirling petals.
history: Municipal flag of Tsushima, a city in Nagasaki Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 1 March 2004.

features.role: Tsushima city emblem — a stylised flower of five swirling petals
